_comment: Hazards and events (see Hazards.cs and Events.cs). Rocks: asteroid belts, planetary rings and battle debris. Expected hits a day for one ship = rockHitsPerDay x density x (speed / rockSpeed) x the ship's cross-section (by size: small under 100 m, medium under 200 m, large under 300 m, huge above). Each hit takes rockHitHull of full hull at rockSpeed, more the faster the ship goes (up to maxSpeedFactor), and sometimes wears the engines. Hits a crossing therefore stay the same at any speed but each hurts more: fast is risky, slow is safe. Hazards never take hull below hullFloor or a bar below barFloor, so they wear ships down without destroying them. Working point defence clears pdClears of the hits, for heat. Research: debris-shielding halves the damage, rock-mapping cuts hits in belts and rings.
_debrisComment: Battle debris: a battle with at least debrisMinLosses ships lost or crippled leaves a cloud of wreckage where it was fought, debrisStartMm wide, spreading to debrisEndMm and thinning to nothing over debrisDays. Density debrisDensity, plus debrisPerLoss for each loss past the first two (at most debrisMaxDensity). Debris hurts all sizes much alike: a ship's cross-section counts only debrisSizeShare of its size.
_radiationComment: Radiation belts round the gas giants: crewed ships lose radCrewPerDay of the crew bar a day inside one (down to radCrewFloor); every ship's electronics wear radWearPerDay off the defence bar (down to radWearFloor). Ships with shields take radShieldCut of it. Radiation shielding research halves it.
_sunComment: Close to the sun: inside sunHotAu ships gain sunHeatPerHour x ((sunHotAu / distance)^2 - 1) heat an hour. Sensors looking within sunDazzleDegrees of the sun see sunDazzleFactor as far.
_routesComment: The rival (and the route planner's warning) count a route's expected hull loss for its worst-hit ship; above slowAbove the rival flies slower.
_eventsComment: Events: each side gets one about every perSideDays (by the game-start setting Off, Rare, Normal, Lively), the first after firstDay, the gap rolled between half and one and a half times that. Weights pick the kind among those that can happen now. askHours is how long a call waits for the player before Auto picks (never later than the event hits).
